distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) record Fujian and Sichuan under Xyleborus armipennis. Smith et al. (2020) confirms Fujian/Sichuan and adds Guangxi under Cyclorhipidion miyazakiense. Smith et al. (2022) reports Fujian, Guangxi, Sichuan and Yunnan, adding Yunnan with locality evidence from Honghe.

host_note: Baseline Castanopsis spp., Lithocarpus sp. and Quercus sp. host evidence is retained. Smith et al. (2020) independently reports Castanopsis and Quercus at genus level. Smith et al. (2022) provides no host in the curated record, so no host update is made.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cyclorhipidion miyazakiense (Murayama, 1936).
